The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with an operating income of 749M (19% margin) and a healthy equity base of 21,181M, which supports its capacity to service its obligations. However, its massive balance sheet leverage (total liabilities of 57,973M relative to 79,154M in total assets) and a weak current ratio of 0.79 (current assets of 5,681M vs current liabilities of 7,148M) present elevated short-term liquidity risks that constrain the credit profile to the upper-medium investment grade. 

DECISION: A-
